subject: executor, planner: minimize the context used by the `ranger` package (#52363)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its first parent, focusing on executor/planner/session/sessionctx call paths into `ranger`. The new `session.GetRangerCtx()` builds a per-statement cached `ranger/context.RangerContext` from `StmtCtx` (TypeCtx/ErrCtx/ExprCtx + RangeFallback/plan-cache-skip handlers), and the refactor consistently replaces `GetSessionVars().StmtCtx.*` usage inside range-building with these fields without changing error handling, timezone semantics, or plan-cache skip/fallback behavior. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn, privilege/visibility, or concurrency issues found in the touched areas.
